description.value: Ban Chok Dee is an award-winning Thai restaurant in Langley City holding 'Thai Select Premium' status granted by the Royal Thai Consulate General for authentic and outstanding Thai cuisine. The restaurant uses a mix of locally grown and imported traditional ingredients and offers a full sit-down dining environment styled with traditional Thai decor. A second location operates in Maple Ridge, and both can host large groups of up to 80 people.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, award-winning Thai restaurant at 20563 Douglas Crescent, Langley, matching the OSM record in name, phone, and address. The 'Order Online' feature on the website confirms takeout availability; no bike-specific amenities (parking, water refill, pump, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those are null. The 2016 Thai Select Premium certification from the Royal Thai Consulate General and group-dining capacity up to 80 people are notable distinguishing features.
concerns: OSM address ('20563 Douglas Crescent') lacks city/province/postal code; website provides the full address '20563 Douglas Crescent, Langley, BC V3A 4B6' which was used for the listing.
All three required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are unconfirmed from available evidence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Ban Chok Dee is a legitimate, operating full-service restaurant that could serve touring cyclists well, but no bike-specific amenities (parking, water refill, washrooms confirmation) are evidenced from the website, leaving the required WWC criteria all null. A site visit or direct contact is needed to confirm minimum required criteria before inclusion.
